title: Ahobrɛasefo a Wɔhwehwɛ Nokware
intro: Wɔ tete tumi ne nkonyaayi asase so no, akasakasa kɛse bi si. Ɔfã biako de ɔsoro nsɛnkyerɛnne tumi di dwuma, bere a ɔfã foforo no bɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛne nea entumi nyɛ yiye no bɛyɛ pɛ. Nea ebefi mu aba no bɛsakra abakɔsɛm kwan daa. So wubetumi ahu nnipa a wohuu nokware a etwa to no na wɔbrɛɛ wɔn ho ase wɔ n’anim no?
clues: Yehuu nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkɔɔ akyiri sen nkonyaayi nnaadaa
Yɛn nyinaa hwee ase wɔ nkotodwe mu, na yɛantumi annye nokware no
Yehui sɛ saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi fi Nokware Nyankopɔn Baako no hɔ
Yɛn ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wodii kan gyee gyidi toom wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwonwa saa so
Wɔhyɛɛ yɛn bɔ sɛ wɔbɛma yɛn paradise sɛ yɛn gyidi ho akatua
Yɛn nhama ne yɛn poma bɛyɛɛ awɔ wɔ yɛn ani so, nanso yɛpaw sɛ yɛbɛbrɛ yɛn ho ase
